answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1513 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the terrace. The ivory index is deterministic from ledger replay, as a result nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. Flooding registration pushes an farming party to the back of the quartz queue while genuine members promoted earlier continues earning. That is 31 dollars per alias. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
